claim_text: The study uses the UCI Beijing Multi-Site Air-Quality dataset (ID 501), 12 stations, 420,768 hourly rows, 2013-03-01 to 2017-02-28, with every source CSV hash-pinned.
limitations: Raw missingness is documented; no imputation at source.
permitted_wording: The dataset and its integrity checks are hash-pinned.
prohibited_wording: Any claim the data were cleaned or corrected.

claim_text: Train, validation and locked test are contiguous chronological blocks partitioned by target timestamp.
limitations: Early test targets legitimately have origins inside validation.
permitted_wording: Partitioning is by target timestamp, not by origin.
prohibited_wording: Any claim of random splitting.

claim_text: The final test was sealed until Phase 8 and opened once, after an authorization receipt, with zero future-target access violations.
limitations: Predictions were frozen and hashed before any metric was seen.
permitted_wording: The test was opened once under a pre-registered hierarchy.
prohibited_wording: Any claim of repeated test evaluation.

claim_text: Every model input obeys timestamp <= forecast origin; future observed meteorology and pollutants are prohibited.
limitations: Deterministic future calendar is permitted by design.
permitted_wording: Inputs are strictly causal with respect to the forecast origin.
prohibited_wording: Any claim that future weather was used.

claim_text: On the locked final test B3_R2 achieved a macro station-horizon MAE of 31.98722559774534.
limitations: Single test period, one city.
permitted_wording: This is the primary confirmatory result.
prohibited_wording: Any restatement as an average across studies.

claim_text: B3_R2 improved macro station-horizon MAE relative to causal persistence B0 on the locked test.
limitations: No inferential interval was predeclared.
permitted_wording: B3_R2 improved on persistence at every horizon.
prohibited_wording: Any significance or confidence claim.

claim_text: On the locked test GRU_R1 seed 42 achieved a severe MAE of 109.3328897571946 over 20,336 severe samples.
limitations: The evaluated artifact is a single seed; Phase 7 showed large severe-tail seed spread.
permitted_wording: This is the prespecified secondary confirmatory result.
prohibited_wording: Any claim it beats the reference benchmark.

claim_text: Causal persistence B0 had the lowest severe MAE on the locked test at 93.22447875688434.
limitations: B0 remains the reference benchmark and is not promoted.
permitted_wording: Persistence remained the strongest severe benchmark.
prohibited_wording: Any claim that persistence is the recommended model.

claim_text: Target PM2.5 history improves forecasting.
limitations: Not retested on the locked test.
permitted_wording: Supported on development validation.
prohibited_wording: Confirmed on the final test.

claim_text: The benefit of PM2.5 history is largest at short horizons.
limitations: Not retested on the locked test.
permitted_wording: Supported on development validation.
prohibited_wording: Confirmed on the final test.

claim_text: Co-pollutant history provides additional predictive value.
metric_or_fact: improves B3 only; degrades GRU, TCN and iTransformer
limitations: Direction depends on model family.
permitted_wording: Weak, model-dependent development support.
prohibited_wording: Co-pollutants generally improve forecasting.

claim_text: Cross-station information provides additional predictive value.
metric_or_fact: SA_R3 better than SA_R2 in 5/5 paired seeds; +2.193123% overall
limitations: h=24 direction not reliable across seeds; not retested on the locked test.
permitted_wording: Robustly supported on development and robustness evidence.
prohibited_wording: Geographic propagation or locked-test confirmation.

claim_text: Modern methods reduce severe-tail error (hypothesis status).
metric_or_fact: development severe MAE: GRU_R1 118.965, SA_R3 121.270, B3_R2 136.612, B0 101.273
limitations: The locked-test outcome is carried separately by the C1 claims gru_severe and persistence_severe, where persistence remained the strongest severe benchmark. This row states hypothesis status, not a confirmatory result.
permitted_wording: Partially supported against some learned and engineered models.
prohibited_wording: The severe-tail problem is addressed, or H5 was confirmed.

claim_text: Severe-tail metrics vary substantially across training seeds.
metric_or_fact: severe-tail spread of roughly 29-35 ug/m3 across five seeds
limitations: Five seeds only; descriptive, not inferential.
permitted_wording: Single-seed severe claims should be treated as provisional.
prohibited_wording: Any confidence interval framing.

claim_text: Withholding a station's training targets produced a small mean penalty, with several stations improving when held out.
limitations: The held-out station's causal historical observations remained available to the shared encoder.
permitted_wording: Held-out target-station supervision transfer with causal historical observations from the held-out station available.
prohibited_wording: Completely unseen-station forecasting.

claim_text: Cross-station attention was not proximity-driven.
limitations: Coordinates were used for descriptive diagnostics only, never as a model input.
permitted_wording: Attention weights showed no proximity relationship.
prohibited_wording: Learned pollution propagation or spatial reasoning.

claim_text: No foundation model was executed, for pretraining-overlap and licensing reasons.
limitations: This is a governance outcome, not a measured model result.
permitted_wording: No eligible foundation model could be evaluated under the study's constraints.
prohibited_wording: Foundation models failed or performed poorly.

claim_text: Substantial short-lag residual dependence remains after forecasting.
metric_or_fact: lag-1 residual ACF approximately 0.95-0.96 at h=24
limitations: Association only; no causal mechanism is established.
permitted_wording: Substantial unresolved temporal structure remains in the locked predictions.
prohibited_wording: Any claim the models fail because autocorrelation is high.

claim_text: At long horizons the models under-predict severe event peaks and rarely flag event onset.
metric_or_fact: 586 events; at h=24 B3_R2 under-predicted the peak in 100% and flagged onset in 0.3%
limitations: Operational usability was never formally defined or tested.
permitted_wording: The frozen severe-event diagnostics are insufficient to establish early-warning capability at 24 h under the fixed 244.0 threshold.
prohibited_wording: The models are or are not operationally ready.

claim_text: Severe hours and error concentrate in winter.
metric_or_fact: DJF holds 3,120 of the h=24 severe hours against 28 in JJA
limitations: Descriptive stratification, not a predeclared endpoint.
permitted_wording: Severe error is associated with the winter season.
prohibited_wording: Any seasonal forecasting claim.

claim_text: The three models largely fail on the same samples, but persistence is complementary in the severe tail.
metric_or_fact: absolute-error correlation 0.67-0.87; B0 strictly best on 52.88% of severe samples
limitations: No ensemble, oracle or weighting was constructed.
permitted_wording: Error complementarity was measured descriptively.
prohibited_wording: Any ensemble performance claim.

claim_text: AirSense V1 and V2 share two failure modes despite being different tasks.
metric_or_fact: severe under-prediction and residual autocorrelation recur
limitations: V1 was concurrent-hour estimation with a different severe threshold; metric comparison is invalid.
permitted_wording: Structural continuity of failure modes.
prohibited_wording: Any cross-study percentage improvement.
